description: This file contains unit tests for the SharedMemoryBuffer component, specifically testing mapping, unmapping, data access, and size retrieval functionalities for different media playback types such as GENERIC and WEB_AUDIO within the Rialto media server project.

classes.description: Test fixture class for SharedMemoryBuffer unit tests, providing setup and utility functions.
